versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "scraping-tweets-from-account" skill.
- Scrapes all tweets, replies, and media from any public Twitter/X account using Apify's Tweet scraper.
- Returns tweet text, likes, retweets, replies, media URLs, and timestamp for each tweet.
- Supports advanced search options, filtering by user, media type, geolocation, engagement, and date range.
- Provides guidance for use with Apify tools, REST API, and includes output and troubleshooting details.
